t: What Does The Name Gaard Mean?
s: Gaard is a masculine given name and surname of Germanic-Norse origin, most commonly linked to the Old Norse and Old High German word garðr/gaard/garth meaning “enclosure,” “farmstead,” or “yard,” and by extension “homestead” or “protector of the home.” In Scandinavia, it often appears as Gaard, Gård, or in compound surnames like Iversen-Gaard, while related forms include the Norwegian/Danish gård (farm), the English toponymic Garth, the Dutch/German Gerd/Gerdt (from Gerhard), and the Faroese/Old Norse Garðar (“enclosures; farms,” also seen in the historical name Garðaríki for Rus’).
